item.title: Anthropic Breaks Down Five Building Blocks of Always-On Agents
item.description:
Anthropic published 'Building always-on agents' by William Hu, breaking down the five core components of persistent AI agents: event-driven inbox wake-up, timer-based proactive triggers, persistent memory folders, account permission constraints, and outbox output control. The piece covers concurrent event conflict handling, memory frugality, human approval for sensitive actions, and why agents should start out quiet.

原文标题：Anthropic 拆解 24 小时在线 Agent 的五大构件

Why it matters：Anthropic 官方首次系统化拆解常驻 Agent 的工程架构，对构建生产级 Agent 的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: SBF's $500M Anthropic Bet Would Be Worth $37B at IPO
item.description:
FT reports that Sam Bankman-Fried's Alameda Research Ventures bought nearly 14% of Anthropic in 2021 for $500M at a roughly $4B valuation; at next week's expected IPO price that stake would be worth about $37B. After FTX's collapse, the bankruptcy estate sold the stake in 2024 for about $1.3B. The same fund also took about 5% of Cursor maker Anysphere for $200K in 2022 and sold it for the same amount in 2023; at the $60B SpaceX paid for Anysphere, that stake would be worth about $3B.

原文标题：SBF 当年 5 亿美元投资 Anthropic 如今价值约 370 亿美元

Why it matters：以 Anthropic 预期 IPO 定价为锚，量化 FTX 破产财产过早出售股份的机会成本，是观察 AI 资产估值膨胀的典型样本。

item.description:

item.title: llama.cpp Hits 1.0.0 with Support for Over 150 Model Architectures
item.description:
llama.cpp and its underlying tensor library ggml have officially reached version 1.0.0, establishing a semantic versioning scheme that flags breaking changes to the public C API. The project now supports over 150 model architecture variants and mainstream speculative decoding methods, backed by expanded self-hosted CI runners across NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, Arm, IBM and Intel hardware.

Why it matters：本地推理事实标准项目首次发布 1.0.0 并确立 API 兼容性契约，对依赖其构建应用的开发者具有直接工程价值。

item.title: Fed Flags AI as Top Financial Risk for Wall Street
item.description:
The Fed's financial stability report shows 87% of polled market professionals now name AI as the top financial risk, up from 50% in spring. AI infrastructure debt surpassed $680B by October, roughly 5x all of 2023 and about 31% of investment-grade corporate borrowing, while big tech and chipmakers carry over $3T in future leases and guarantees that may understate true AI exposure. GPU makers guarantee chip values and invest in the same buyers, creating circular financing, and the largest US banks hold close to $1T of exposure to big tech and data center builders.

原文标题：美联储警示 AI 成华尔街头号金融风险

Why it matters：美联储官方报告首次将 AI 列为头号金融风险，并给出债务规模与循环融资的量化证据，是判断 AI 资本周期风险的关键信号。

item.title: China's MIIT Moves to Form Industrial OS Standards Working Group
item.description:
China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) is accelerating the formation of a standards working group for industrial operating systems, alongside drafting and validating key standards to support large-scale adoption. Industrial OS is positioned as a critical foundation for AI-enabled industry, shifting from single-project pilots toward reusable common platforms plus industry-specific capabilities. A companion AI-plus-software initiative targets 20,000 large software firms by 2028, while IDC forecasts China's industrial enterprise AI spending to reach RMB 280 billion by 2030.

item.title: Multi-Agent Red-Blue Loop Auto-Generates and Proves Detection Rules
item.description:
Detection-as-Code Foundry builds an adversarial multi-agent detection-engineering workflow on LangGraph, Pydantic, FastMCP and Claude, turning threats such as CVEs, CISA KEV entries and ATT&CK techniques into Sigma detection rules hardened through a Blue-vs-Red loop. Its key contribution is shipping a threat report and a reproducible proof bundle with positive corpus, benign baseline, adversarial mutations, FP/FN numbers and a computed coverage label, making rule validity verifiable rather than asserted.

原文标题：多智能体红蓝对抗自动生成并验证检测规则

Why it matters：把检测规则生成升级为可证明的红蓝对抗闭环，是智能体在安全工程落地的少见完整范式。

item.title: China Releases National Standard for Smart Factories in Process Industries
item.description:
China's market regulator approved GB/T 48536-2026, a national standard governing business management for smart factories in process industries, effective May 1, 2027. The standard introduces the first unified management framework spanning R&D, manufacturing, operations, supply-chain collaboration and management methods, and mandates a unified industrial big-data platform covering the full production flow, while promoting digital twins and AI for scheduling optimization and abnormal-condition handling. It has been piloted at representative petrochemical, metallurgy and pharmaceutical enterprises.

原文标题：流程工业智能工厂新国标发布 2027 年 5 月实施

Why it matters：国家级智能工厂标准落地，为流程工业的 AI 与数据平台建设提供统一合规标尺，直接影响石化、冶金、制药企业的数字化路线选择。

item.title: Thinking Machines Open-Sources 594B-Parameter 4-Bit Trained Model
item.description:
Thinking Machines Lab has fulfilled its promise by open-sourcing Inkling 2 Small under Apache 2.0, a 594B-parameter model trained with native 4-bit forward passes from the first pretraining step through the final RL rollout. The 4-bit approach cut pretraining time by 8% and RL time by 20% for roughly 2% efficiency loss, and the released checkpoint requires no separate calibration.

原文标题：Thinking Machines 开源 594B 参数 4-bit 训练模型

Why it matters：端到端 4-bit 训练在超大规模模型上落地并开源，为低精度训练与推理提供了可复现的工程范式。

item.title: GS Caltex Cuts Model Deployment from a Week to Hours with SageMaker
item.description:
South Korean energy and chemical company GS Caltex connected no-code modeling in SageMaker Canvas with deployment orchestration in SageMaker Pipelines, automating the handoff between the two. Its ML engineers now deploy models in hours instead of about a week, and run batch inference every 30 minutes instead of keeping endpoints always on.

item.title: Microsoft Apologizes for Global Outage Caused by Network Capacity Upgrade
item.description:
Microsoft apologized for the global outage on November 12 that hit core Microsoft 365 cloud services and the connectivity components used by OpenAI and Anthropic. The company confirmed the fault stemmed from an issue in an earlier network capacity upgrade exposed by a later network change, unrelated to cyberattacks or AI. The underlying issue is resolved, services are largely restored, and a full postmortem is pending.

item.title: OpenAI Reorganizes Embodied AI Team to Make GPT-6 Astra the Robot Brain
item.description:
OpenAI has confirmed it dissolved its standalone robotics team, folding researchers into core research and hardware staff into the applications division, stressing the move accelerates rather than exits robotics. The company says general models including GPT-6 Astra can already handle some robotic tasks, and it aims to make multimodal general models the robot brain instead of relying on robotics-specific models. An Nvidia study cited Astra-driven agents hitting 74.8% success on a simulated manipulation benchmark versus 51.0% for leading specialized models, though inference speed, cloud dependency and field data remain practical hurdles.

原文标题：OpenAI 重组具身智能团队 让 GPT-6 Astra 充当机器人大脑

Why it matters：OpenAI 明确将通用大模型定位为机器人“大脑”，并给出可量化的对比数据，是具身智能技术路线的重要信号。

The approach targets the limitations of Unicode Box Drawing characters in TUI design and is currently at the discussion and prototype stage, with feedback sought in the Ghostty community.

item.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore V2 Uses Snapshots to Speed Session Startup
item.description:
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime introduces platformVersion V2, which prepares the environment once, snapshots it, and restores that snapshot per session instead of initializing a container each time, yielding faster and more consistent session starts. V2 also reclaims unused session memory so billing tracks actual usage; most agents benefit from a simple version switch, while some need restructuring.

原文标题：亚马逊 Bedrock AgentCore V2 快照恢复加速会话启动

Why it matters：这是智能体托管运行时在会话启动机制上的实质架构优化，对构建低延迟交互式智能体的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: FAA 将 AI 空管系统扩展至全美空域
item.description:
